notes: Merged old kinds Clear quartz, Amethyst, Rose quartz, Smoky quartz and Citrine into Quartz with varieties as archetypes (Japan-law twin, Herkimer, ametrine, prasiolite, rutilated, milky, tiger's eye added). Agate gets classic locality agates plus chalcedony varieties; old model Crazy Lace Agate became an archetype, Grape Agate kept in m (no source fetched). Jasper: Bumblebee and Ocean jasper flagged as trade names for non-jasper rocks; Cosmic Jasper kept in m (unsourced). Opal: Yowah Matrix Boulder Opal became a version of Yowah nut. Left out: Otome mine (Japan-law type locality) because Mindat returned 403; Dryhead discovery year and Condor 1993 date (uncited); thunder eggs and geodes left to the Rocks shelf. No brands (no makers on this shelf).
